name: asc-signing-setup
activation: `command -v asc` succeeds, `asc auth status --validate` passes, and the user confirms a paid Apple Developer Program account.
prerequisites: A paid Apple Developer Program account.
The asc CLI on PATH with an App Store Connect API key (the .p8 key downloads only once).
The Account Holder role for Developer ID certificates.
A git repository for encrypted signing sync.
An Apple ID web session for App Groups.
risks: Revokes certificates, deletes profiles and pushes signing material (SKILL.md:66-85) behind --confirm only; it says to review the plan (:137) but never to ask the user.
